name: cadranote
description: Extension Chrome de sélection HTML pour les assistants IA

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/build-tests.mjs && node --test .test-build/session-machine.test.cjs tests/locator.test.cjs
scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/package.ps1
